name: FORNO® 36" 20 Cu. Ft. Fingerprint Resistant Stainless Steel Built-In Side-by-Side Refrigerator
shortDescription: The 40” Forno french door refrigerator with Decorative Grill offers a frost-free, free-standing design with a multi air flow cooling system, with an overall 20 Cu. Ft. capacity and adjustable shelving to accommodate all your grocery needs. Touch screen control provides intuitive and quick access to temperature controls.

features.text: Door opening alarm, child lock mode, vacation mode, convenient fast freeze setting and bright white energy-efficient LED lighting offers elegant illumination throughout the interior. Fresh food compartment has a capacity of 12.12 cu.ft. with 3 adjustable glass shelves, 1 gallon bins, and easy access crisper drawers when doors are opened at 90°. Two pull out drawers accommodating 7.14 cu. ft. of freezer capacity and Ice Maker. Housed in food safe stainless-steel and a decorative grill that allows ample ventilation while sporting a stylish look that is built to last. All Forno refrigerators are backed by an iron clad 2-year warranty for your satisfaction and an E-star energy rating.
The 36-inch Salerno, enhanced with modern decorative trim grill, extends to a width of 40 inches and giving it a built-in appearance.
Fingerprint-resistant VCM stainless steel keeps the fridge clean, polished, and enhances kitchen aesthetics effortlessly.
Fresh Food storage capacity of 13.48 cu.ft. & Freezer storage capacity of 6.53 cu.ft.
Fresh food compartment includes 4 spill-proof shelves, 4 door bins and 2 drawers.
Freezer compartment includes 2 spill-proof glass shelves, 2 storage drawers and 2 door bins.
Door dispenser that gives you the option of ice cubes, ice crushing & ice water.
Produces 4 pounds of ice daily for a constant supply with efficient built-in ice maker.
High-efficiency LED lighting ensures uniform illumination, making every corner visible and preventing food spoilage
The compressor inverter ensures energy efficiency, quiet operation, and precise temperature control for optimal performance.
